summary: Describes common misinterpretations and ambiguities in Signaling Compression (SigComp), a scheme for compressing messages from protocols such as SIP, and gives developers guidance. It updates RFC 3320, RFC 3321, and RFC 3485. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Some rules for squeezing messages smaller were confusing. This note clears up the confusing parts so everyone squeezes and unsqueezes the same way.
